## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `asana-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Navigate to the developer console

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your Asana account. -->
2. <!-- manual: Go to the [Asana Developer Console](https://app.asana.com/0/my-apps). -->

## Step 3: Create a personal access token

1. Select **+ Create new token**.
2. Enter a descriptive **Token name** (for example, `Ballerina Asana Connector`).
3. <!-- manual: Enter a descriptive Token name (for example, Ballerina Asana Connector). -->
4. <!-- manual: Read and accept the Asana API Terms and Conditions. -->
5. Select **Create token**.
6. <!-- manual: Copy the generated token immediately — it will not be shown again. -->

## Step 4: Find your workspace GID

1. <!-- manual: Open Asana in your browser and navigate to any project. -->
2. The workspace GID appears in the URL, or you can retrieve it via the `GET /workspaces` endpoint after configuring the connector.
